response.sql: WITH state_counts AS (SELECT c.state, COUNT(*) AS matched_records FROM player_college AS pc JOIN college AS c ON pc.college_id = c.college_id GROUP BY c.state) SELECT state, matched_records, 1.0 * matched_records / SUM(matched_records) OVER () AS share FROM state_counts

assumptions.assumption: Blank ('') and missing (NULL) states are separate groups.

alternatives.interpretation: Blank and missing states form one group, reported as NULL.
alternatives.sql: WITH state_counts AS (SELECT NULLIF(c.state, '') AS state, COUNT(*) AS matched_records FROM player_college AS pc JOIN college AS c ON pc.college_id = c.college_id GROUP BY NULLIF(c.state, '')) SELECT state, matched_records, 1.0 * matched_records / SUM(matched_records) OVER () AS share FROM state_counts
